g.text: Records up to this lsn are on the
device already. It is the flush
barrier: a read pins it, so the
records past it stay in the journal
The user no longer needs the
records up to this lsn - they may be
flushed to the device and dropped
from the journal. Persisted in the
The last indexed record, acked to
the writer. Every record up to it is
chained and its pages can be read
